body_excerpt: ## What's Changed * Fix Identity defaults for V4 and V5 encryption filters by @yhay81 in https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/pull/624 * Honor decompression limits in object streams and PNG predictors by @yhay81 in https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/pull/625 * Preserve page attributes and outlines in merge examples by @yhay81 in https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/pull/626 * Raise the PDF version when plain saves write an xref stream by @yhay81 in https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/pull/627 * fix: default BitsPerComponent to 1 for inline image masks by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/pull/628 * fix: find EI after any white-space character when skipping inline images by @LuisFigueroaG in https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/pull/629 * perf: traverse and prune in linear time by @yhay81 in https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/pull/630 * perf: delete the objects of delete_pages and delete_zero_length_streams in one traversal by @yhay81 in https://github.com/J-F-Liu/lopdf/pull/631 * fix:
